body:
EQT AB (“EQT”) is pleased to announce that it has signed an agreement to acquire Stockbridge (“Stockbridge” and the “Transaction”), a leading U.S. real estate investment manager with approximately USD 16.5 billion in fee-generating assets under management.

Founded in 2003 and headquartered in San Francisco, Stockbridge has approximately 185 professionals across six U.S. offices and approximately 180 institutional clients. The firm is principal-led and designed around a client-centric model with specialist depth in traditional property sectors and subsectors, including Industrial Outdoor Storage, alternative living including Manufactured Housing, and established open-ended core products.

The Transaction brings together Stockbridge’s established U.S. investment franchises, experienced investment teams, and sector capabilities with EQT Real Estate’s industrial leadership, global client reach, operator-led investment model, and differentiated data and AI capabilities. The combination is designed to broaden client access to real estate strategies benefiting from long-term structural tailwinds, including attractive industrial sub-sectors and alternative living strategies, while preserving specialist-led investment teams and a disciplined focus on performance. This marks an important step in EQT Real Estate’s continued evolution toward a more thematically diversified global platform.

Investors increasingly seek access to platforms that combine sector diversification, specialist operating capabilities, and the ability to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns across market cycles. EQT Real Estate is well positioned to meet that demand, having more than doubled in size since 2021 to become a leading global sector-specialist manager, with consistent top-quartile performance underpinned by a vertically integrated, operator-led model, local market presence, and proprietary data and AI capabilities.

Per Franzén, CEO and Managing Partner of EQT, said: "Our Real Estate platform is an important part of EQT's offering to our clients, and this combination represents a significant next step in the development of the business. Stockbridge has built an impressive track record over more than two decades and is an excellent fit with EQT Real Estate. Both sides will learn and develop from one another while contributing to the wider EQT platform. The combination broadens what we can offer our clients: additional thematic strategies supported by specialist investment teams that will benefit from EQT's global sourcing, operating, and distribution capabilities."

Henry Steinberg, Global Head of EQT Real Estate, said: "This transaction will enable us to deliver the attractive risk-adjusted returns our clients have come to expect from EQT Real Estate across a broader range of sectors. It will expand our industrial platform and broaden client access to complementary strategies, accelerating EQT Real Estate’s evolution into a more thematically diversified real estate manager, while staying true to our sector-specialist, local-with-locals approach. In turn, we bring EQT's international platform, global market intelligence, and our proprietary data and AI capabilities and tools to enhance how Stockbridge sources, underwrites, and manages assets, and we hope to sharpen both firms' investment frameworks to further cement our position as a leading investor and operator. We are deeply impressed by what the Stockbridge team has built and we are excited about the opportunities this next phase of growth will create for our clients, our people and the broader EQT Real Estate platform."

Terry Fancher, CEO of Stockbridge, said: “Over more than two decades, Stockbridge has built a leading real estate investment platform grounded in disciplined execution, diversification, and a steadfast commitment to our clients. Joining EQT Real Estate enables us to continue delivering differentiated strategies to the market through the same teams and investment philosophy that have built our track record, while benefiting from EQT’s global reach and operating platform. EQT has built a leading global alternative investment platform, and we believe its investment approach, client focus and people-centric culture are closely aligned with our values and long-term vision. We are excited to bring our expertise to EQT to broaden its investment offerings and exposure across both traditional and alternative real estate sectors, while maintaining the investment rigor and client-first mindset that have defined Stockbridge since our founding. We look forward to building this next chapter of the platform together.”

Organizational set-up and governance

Following closing, our priority will be to continue delivering for clients across EQT Real Estate and Stockbridge’s strategies and to ensure business continuity, while advancing the strategic objectives of the combination. The integration will be led by the firms’ operational and business development teams, allowing the investment teams to continue focusing on generating alpha for our clients.

Stockbridge’s diversified strategies and alternative sectors will operate as a dedicated business line within EQT Real Estate, while its industrial capabilities will be brought together with EQT Real Estate’s existing industrial platform. Existing leadership, investment teams and decision-making processes will largely remain in place, preserving our local, sector-specialist approach, with Stockbridge increasingly leveraging EQT’s global client and operating platform over time. Stockbridge CEO Terry Fancher will become Vice Chair of EQT Real Estate, reporting to Henry Steinberg. Stockbridge CFO Kristin Renaudin will become Global CFO of EQT Real Estate, and Tuba Malinowski, currently Executive Managing Director at Stockbridge, will become Head of U.S. Diversified Real Estate. Stockbridge will transition to the EQT Real Estate brand at closing, while existing funds will retain their current naming conventions.
